entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Compat for old assets #50018
  • New SDK Tool generation has trouble packing nested files that are not directly in the tool root #50014
  • dotnet-format verify-no-changes throw error for AOT app API #50012
  • Feature Request: Export user-secrets keys as appsettings.template.json for safer environment config sharing #50011
  • dotnet new sln "--format" missing in 10.0.100 preview (--format slnx broken) #50008
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With 10.0.100-preview.7.25380.105 EXE, returning to manifest mode fails with missing package error #50006
    Discussion
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With 10.0.100-preview.7.25380.105, MAUI workload installation fails due to missing NuGet packages #50005

Closed

  • IntelliSense Not Functioning in VS Code for File-Based C# Apps Using dotnet run app.cs #49293
  • Need to include common analyzers in our R2R generation #49675
    10.0.1xx
  • [API Compat] Adding a new value to a public enum is not detected as a breaking change #45929
    Backlog
  • [API Compat] Adding a new public member to an unsealed public class is not detected as a breaking change #47194

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove unused method #50017
  • Allow users to override packaging implementation in generated tool packages #50015
    Area-Tools
  • Unskip test cases #50010
  • Unskip run-file tests #50009
    Test Debt, Area-run-file

Merged

  • [automated] Update man pages #50007
  • Crossgen NetAnalyzers and Razor generators #50003
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49947
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-CodeFlow

Updated

  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49954
    Area-CLI
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Avoid unnecessary evaluations during `dotnet run file.cs` #49991
    Area-run-file
  • add System.Net.Http.WasmEnableStreamingResponse to RuntimeHostConfigurationOption #50000
    arch-wasm
  • Use BuildManager.Build API and a custom msbuild logger to store props #49728
  • Remove MSBuild hacks for virtual project building #49745
    Area-run-file
  • Exclude default items from file-based apps in project dirs #49999
    Area-run-file
